name: Bethuel
overview: Bethuel is a male biblical figure identified as the son of Nahor and his wife Milcah. He is noted primarily for his role within the family lineage recorded in Genesis 22. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional notes provided about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Bethuel means 'man of God,' which reflects a theistic element common in Hebrew names. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but is recorded explicitly in Genesis 22:22.
familyAndRelationships: Bethuel is the son of Nahor and Milcah, and he is the father of Rebekah. These relationships are explicitly stated in Genesis 22:22-23, situating him within a significant family line in the patriarchal narratives.
scriptureSignificance: Bethuel's importance in Scripture is connected to his position in the ancestral line leading to Rebekah, who plays a crucial role in the covenantal history of Israel. As the father of Rebekah, he is part of the family through which God's promises to Abraham are further realized. His mention establishes the genealogical context necessary for understanding the unfolding of God's redemptive plan.
